protectionCatalog.label: Fixed rate
protectionCatalog.explanation: The stated rate is fixed rather than variable.

protectionCatalog.label: Fixed rate
protectionCatalog.explanation: The agreement says the rate will not change.

protectionCatalog.label: Rate lock
protectionCatalog.explanation: A documented lock protects the quoted rate for the stated period.

protectionCatalog.label: Cancellation window
protectionCatalog.explanation: A stated cancellation or cooling-off window can allow withdrawal under the listed conditions.

protectionCatalog.label: Grace period
protectionCatalog.explanation: The stated grace period limits charges during the documented window.

protectionCatalog.label: No annual fee
protectionCatalog.explanation: An annual fee is waived under the stated conditions.

protectionCatalog.label: No compulsory arbitration
protectionCatalog.explanation: The agreement excludes the stated arbitration requirement.

documentTypes.label: Buy now, pay later / no-cost EMI

feeCatalog.label: Origination fee
feeCatalog.explanation: Upfront charge for creating or setting up the credit.

feeCatalog.label: Documentation fee
feeCatalog.explanation: A documentation charge is added to the transaction cost.

feeCatalog.label: Processing fee
feeCatalog.explanation: Upfront processing or administration charge.

feeCatalog.label: Convenience fee
feeCatalog.explanation: Charge applied for processing a payment or transaction.

feeCatalog.label: Late or missed-payment fee
feeCatalog.explanation: Charge triggered by a late or missed payment.

feeCatalog.label: General fees
feeCatalog.explanation: The clause describes a general transaction charge.

feeCatalog.label: Rescheduling fee
feeCatalog.explanation: Charge for moving a payment date.

feeCatalog.label: Annual fee
feeCatalog.explanation: Recurring annual account charge.

feeCatalog.label: Balance-transfer fee
feeCatalog.explanation: Charge for transferring a balance.

feeCatalog.label: Cash-advance fee
feeCatalog.explanation: Charge for a cash advance.

feeCatalog.label: Foreign-transaction fee
feeCatalog.explanation: Charge on foreign-currency transactions.

feeCatalog.label: Payment-protection add-on
feeCatalog.explanation: Optional or financed payment-protection product; verify enrollment and cancellation terms.

feeCatalog.label: GAP coverage add-on
feeCatalog.explanation: Vehicle add-on that may cover a shortfall between vehicle value and loan balance.

feeCatalog.label: Service contract or warranty add-on
feeCatalog.explanation: Optional protection product that may be included in the financed amount.

feeCatalog.label: Tax on interest or fees
feeCatalog.explanation: Tax assessed on interest or loan fees.

feeCatalog.label: Prepayment or foreclosure charge
feeCatalog.explanation: Charge for repaying or closing the loan early.

feeCatalog.label: Rolled-in negative equity
feeCatalog.explanation: Prior debt may be rolled into the new financing.

feeCatalog.label: Forfeiture of prior payments
feeCatalog.riskReason: The agreement can forfeit amounts already paid.
feeCatalog.explanation: Prior payments may be kept or forfeited if the agreement ends early or payments are missed.

feeCatalog.label: Collateral repossession or auction
feeCatalog.riskReason: The lender may seize or sell collateral after default.
feeCatalog.explanation: The agreement permits recovery or sale of pledged property after a missed-payment trigger.

feeCatalog.label: Acceleration of the balance
feeCatalog.riskReason: A default can make the full balance due earlier than scheduled.
feeCatalog.explanation: An acceleration clause can make the remaining balance due after a specified breach.

feeCatalog.label: Cross-default
feeCatalog.riskReason: A breach of a separate agreement may trigger default under this contract.
feeCatalog.explanation: Cross-default terms can connect this loan to obligations in another agreement.

feeCatalog.label: Default trigger
feeCatalog.riskReason: The clause defines a default event that can activate other contract remedies.
feeCatalog.explanation: A default trigger identifies when the agreement's remedies may apply.

feeCatalog.label: Ownership only after final payment
feeCatalog.riskReason: The buyer does not own the item until all required payments are made.
feeCatalog.explanation: Ownership is conditional on completing the full payment schedule.

feeCatalog.label: No-credit-check marketing
feeCatalog.riskReason: No-credit-check marketing can accompany high-cost or restrictive terms; verify the total payable and ownership conditions.
feeCatalog.explanation: No-credit-check access is a pricing-risk signal and does not establish that the offer is affordable.

feeCatalog.label: Early-purchase option
feeCatalog.explanation: The agreement describes an option to purchase before the scheduled end.

feeCatalog.label: Penal or overdue interest rate
feeCatalog.riskReason: The stated rate applies because of late payment or default, not to the ordinary balance.
feeCatalog.explanation: This is a conditional default rate and is separate from the agreement's base rate.

feeCatalog.label: Amount deducted from proceeds
feeCatalog.explanation: An upfront amount is withheld from the cash proceeds even if the loan balance remains unchanged.

feeCatalog.label: Payment demanded before credit is released
feeCatalog.riskReason: A fee is demanded before the promised credit or funds are released.
feeCatalog.explanation: An advance payment before credit delivery is a strong fraud warning.

feeCatalog.label: Unilateral change to rates or terms
feeCatalog.riskReason: The provider can change rates, fees, or terms without the borrower's agreement.
feeCatalog.explanation: A unilateral change clause can make the repayment terms uncertain.

feeCatalog.label: Dealer compensation or markup
feeCatalog.explanation: The dealer or intermediary may receive compensation tied to this transaction.

feeCatalog.label: Discount or interest offset
feeCatalog.explanation: A stated discount or cashback offsets the transaction cost.

feeCatalog.label: Tax on financing cost
feeCatalog.explanation: Tax is applied to a stated financing amount or basis.

feeCatalog.label: Gift card, cryptocurrency or wire payment
feeCatalog.explanation: The clause requests payment through the stated gift card, cryptocurrency or wire channel.

feeCatalog.label: Urgent deadline
feeCatalog.explanation: A short deadline pressures the recipient to act before reviewing the terms.

feeCatalog.label: Secrecy from bank or family
feeCatalog.explanation: The clause discourages independent checks with a bank, family member or adviser.

feeCatalog.label: Unofficial contact channel only
feeCatalog.explanation: Contact is restricted to an informal channel, limiting independent verification.

feeCatalog.label: Guaranteed approval
feeCatalog.explanation: An unconditional approval promise should be checked against the actual eligibility and release terms.

feeCatalog.label: Unilateral rate increase
feeCatalog.explanation: The lender can increase the rate at its discretion under the stated clause.

feeCatalog.label: Seizure or repossession without notice
feeCatalog.explanation: The clause permits seizure or repossession without prior notice.

feeCatalog.label: Jury trial waiver
feeCatalog.explanation: The borrower gives up a jury trial for covered disputes.

feeCatalog.label: Class action waiver
feeCatalog.explanation: The clause limits participation in a class action.

feeCatalog.label: Binding arbitration
feeCatalog.explanation: Covered disputes must follow the specified arbitration process.

feeCatalog.label: Confession of judgment
feeCatalog.explanation: The clause authorizes judgment under its stated conditions, potentially limiting the opportunity to contest the claim.

feeCatalog.label: After-acquired property
feeCatalog.explanation: The security interest may extend to property acquired after signing.

categoryGlossary.definition: An optional product or item added to the financed amount can increase the payment and interest over the loan term.
A tax assessed on interest or fees increases the amount paid beyond the stated financing charge.
A discount or cashback reduces cost only to the extent that it is actually applied to the amount owed.
A one-time charge may be paid at signing or added to the financed balance.
A stated benefit changes or expires after its initial period; the later qualifying amount is not a clean protection.
A repeating charge can add to each payment or recur during the agreement.
A contingent charge can apply after a missed payment or other specified event.
A charge may apply when the balance is repaid before the scheduled end of the agreement.
Dealer or intermediary compensation can create an incentive tied to a particular financing offer.
Prior debt may be rolled into a new agreement and increase the amount financed.
A named charge or debt has no stated value, so the disclosed total may be incomplete.
Dispute waivers and unilateral change terms can limit legal options or let one party change the agreement.
The lender may alter the interest rate without a new agreement, making future borrowing costs uncertain.
Requests for advance payment, secrecy, or hard-to-trace payment methods are strong warning signs that should be independently verified.
Short deadlines can pressure a recipient to act before reviewing the contract or verifying the offer.
Claims about guaranteed approval or no-credit-check access do not establish affordability or fund release.
A breach of a separate obligation may trigger default under this agreement.
A default may make the full unpaid balance due earlier than scheduled.
A default trigger defines when the lender may use the agreement's remedies.
The lender may claim, seize, or sell collateral after specified events; notice and scope are material terms.
The rate basis determines how interest is applied; a flat and reducing-balance rate can produce different costs.
A document statement may conflict with listed charges, the repayment terms, or the modeled cost.
An option describes a choice available to a party under the stated conditions and deadlines.
The marketing claim conflicts with another stated term or the calculated cost.
Payment history or missed payments may be reported to credit bureaus under the stated terms.
Amounts already paid may be kept after a missed payment or early termination.
The listed amount does not reconcile with the other stated prices, fees, or proceeds.
Ownership may transfer only after the stated payment or contract conditions are completed.
The agreement permits sharing personal or payment information with the named parties or partners.
The displayed field is withheld because candidate values or arithmetic checks conflict; inspect the named evidence and competing values.

glossary.definition: Interest may be charged later for an earlier promotional period if the required balance is not paid by its deadline.
The amount of credit being advanced, which can include optional products and other rolled-in charges.
Tax added to interest charges; it increases the total paid beyond the stated interest.
A charge that may apply when a loan is paid off or closed before its scheduled end.
Vehicle coverage that may pay some difference between the vehicle's value and the remaining loan balance after a covered loss.
Debt on a trade-in or prior loan that exceeds the asset's value and may be added to the new loan.
A marketing label for installments with no stated interest; fees, taxes, or a higher purchase price can still create a cost.
A charge for handling or setting up a transaction; check whether tax is added and whether it is financed.
A tax assessed on interest adds to the cost of borrowing, even when the stated installment is unchanged.
A discount, rebate, or cashback reduces the amount paid; its effect depends on whether it actually offsets financing costs.
An optional repair or protection product that may be financed with the loan and add interest.
Compensation paid to a dealer or intermediary can create an incentive to offer a particular financing product or rate.
The document refers to a charge or debt without stating its amount, so the disclosed total may be incomplete.

rateBasisFinding.label: Rate basis not stated
rateBasisFinding.explanation: The agreement does not say whether the rate uses a flat or reducing-balance calculation; the standard estimate assumes reducing balance.

findingsUI.protectionExplanation: These clauses provide the stated protections, subject to their documented conditions.
